entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hello, you've reached VeloFit. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
I need to make a return.
I can certainly help with that. Could I get your name and order number to pull up your account?
Sarah Jenkins. The order is VF-881-92B.
Thank you, Sarah. I see your order for the VeloFit Aero helmet. To make sure I understand correctly, what specifically is the issue with the item? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
The color is wrong. I don't like it.
Okay, so just a preference on the color, nothing wrong with the helmet itself or its safety features, correct?
Correct. The box is still unopened. I haven't even touched it.
Understood. Thanks for clarifying. Let me just check the delivery date here... I see it arrived about 57 days ago. One moment while I confirm our policy.
Okay, good news. Since the helmet is a standard item, it falls within our 90-day return window. I can go ahead and approve this return for a full refund for you right now.
Fine. About time something was simple.

I'm generating the return label now and will email it to you. Since the box is unopened, you can just attach the label and send it back. We want to make sure you're happy with your gear, especially with critical safety equipment where the right color for visibility is important.
And Sarah, I see here that you are a VIP member with us. To thank you for your loyalty, I've gone ahead and added a complimentary $20 credit to your account for your next order.
Oh. Well, that's better than nothing, I suppose. Thank you.
You're very welcome. Once we receive the helmet, your refund will be processed within 3 to 5 business days. Was there anything else I could help with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great rest of your day.
